punchline: Wim Hof's first cold step is not an ice bath but the last 30 seconds of an ordinary shower.
thirty_sec: Wim Hof's method has three pillars: cold, breathing and mindset. For cold he starts small, with a four-week programme of showers instead of ice baths. Week one is 30 seconds of cold at the end of a shower, at least five days a week, adding 30 seconds each week until two minutes. If 30 is too much, begin with 15. Researchers are still unsure about the health claims, so check with a doctor first.
